disposition_mapping.rationale: Extraction of locked-period actuals is combined with comparative loading into a single automated pipeline step; the locked-period actuals input (VAR-R-01) is preserved as an input of TGT-01.
Loading of the approved budget version and latest forecast is folded into the same consolidated extraction-and-load pipeline, preserving both required comparative inputs (VAR-R-02) within TGT-01.

Variance computation is restructured into a system-driven calculation step with analyst parameterisation and review, continuing to consume accounting policies applied to actuals (VAR-R-05 / KB-06) and constant-currency exchange rates (VAR-R-06 / KB-07).

Materiality threshold application is restructured into an automated screening step with analyst confirmation, preserving the percentage and absolute thresholds as required inputs (VAR-R-03) and satisfying the step-preservation requirement (VAR-R-08). The selecting actor remains distinct from the reviewing actor in TGT-06, satisfying actor separation (VAR-R-04).
Obtaining budget holder commentary is unconstrained by design and retained with a self-service portal to improve turnaround, without altering its accountable-actor basis.
Consolidation and drafting of the variance report is unconstrained by design and retained, with templated auto-population added for efficiency but no change to inputs, actor, or function.
Review and challenge survives as a discrete FP&A manager step (VAR-R-07), kept organisationally separate from the materiality-selection step to satisfy actor separation (VAR-R-04).
Presentation and distribution to management is unconstrained by design and retained unchanged as the final reporting step.

steps.description: An automated data pipeline pulls actuals from the locked, closed period and loads the approved budget version and latest forecast as comparatives in a single pass, replacing two manual extraction steps with one system-orchestrated load. The FP&A analyst configures and validates the pipeline run and resolves any load exceptions.
steps.name: Extract and consolidate actuals and comparatives

steps.description: A calculation engine computes price, volume and mix variances on actuals and budget prepared on the same accounting basis, isolating the FX effect at constant currency. The FP&A analyst parameterises the run with the current accounting policies and FX rate set and reviews the computed variance dataset for integrity before release.
steps.name: Compute price, volume, mix and FX-isolated variances

steps.description: The variance dataset is automatically screened against the percentage and absolute materiality thresholds to flag variances requiring explanation; the FP&A analyst confirms the threshold parameters applied and reviews borderline or overridden items before the explain-list is finalised. This selecting actor is distinct from the manager who later reviews and challenges the report.
steps.name: Screen variances against materiality thresholds

steps.description: Accountable budget holders are notified via a self-service portal of the variances requiring their explanation and provide commentary directly against each flagged item.
steps.name: Obtain commentary from budget holders

steps.description: Flagged variances and budget holder commentary are consolidated into a draft variance report, with templated narrative sections auto-populated from the underlying dataset to reduce manual drafting effort.
steps.name: Consolidate and draft variance report

steps.description: The FP&A manager reviews and challenges the draft report and its commentary, independent of the analyst who selected which variances required explanation, before it is finalised.
steps.name: Review and challenge

steps.description: The reviewed report is presented and distributed to management.
steps.name: Present and distribute to management
